title: Sign in with your email.
lead: We send you a code. You type it, you’re in.
leadGoogle: With Google, or with a code sent to your email. Never a password.
linkExpired: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one below.
privacy: Private by default. Nothing is published, and no message is sent without your confirmation.

form.noPassword: No password. The code in your email is all you need.
form.sent: Link sent. Open the email sent to {email} and click the link: it signs you in, no password needed.
form.resend: Nothing yet? Check your spam folder, or <link>send a new code</link>.
form.terms: I accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

errors.sendFailed: Couldn’t send the link right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.termsRequired: Tick the box to accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.

waitlist.text: The beta is private for now. {email} doesn’t have an invite yet: I’ll write as soon as your spot is ready.
waitlist.join: Not on the list yet? <link>Join it on wh3re.com</link>.

google.googleFailed: Signing in with Google didn’t work. Try again, or get a link by email.
google.unavailable: The Google button won’t load. Get a link by email instead.

code.label: Code from the email
code.bad: That code doesn’t work. Check the 6 digits, or tap the link in the email.
